info.title: Rustic Cloud API
info.description: Accounts, social, cosmetics store, servers/domains and GDPR endpoints of Rustic Cloud. Errors use the `ErrorBody` envelope. Realtime frames (`ClientMessage`/`ServerMessage`) travel over the realtime service WebSocket.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last UTC day (inclusive), default `from` + 13 days. At most 62 days in all.

202.description: Mail sent if the account exists
Sent if the account exists and is unverified

get.summary: Players met recently who could become friends (ADR 0145).

200.description: JSON archive of all personal data

get.summary: Skin PNG of the signed-in user's linked Minecraft profile.

200.description: The skin PNG (64x64 or legacy 64x32), proxied from Mojang

404.description: `no_minecraft_profile`: no linked Minecraft profile; `no_skin`: the profile uses a default skin

502.description: `skin_upstream_unavailable`, `skin_upstream_invalid`, `skin_url_rejected`, `skin_too_large`, `skin_not_png`: Mojang's services failed or sent something unexpected

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Return messages created strictly before this instant (pagination).

204.description: Unlinked (purchases stay on the Rustic account)

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Only items in this language (`en`, `fr`); all languages when absent.

get.summary:
Exact-match lookup before a friend request (ADR 0145). Same checks and error codes as
`friend_request_send`, so blocked users and accounts that may not receive requests are
indistinguishable (`cannot_add_friend`); the relation is returned instead of the conflicts.

parameters.name: minecraft_name
parameters.description: Exact Minecraft profile name linked to a Rustic account (case-insensitive).

server_address.description: Only forwarded to friends when the user marked the server as shareable.

zone.description: Registrable zone; defaults to the last two labels of `hostname`.

AdminCollection.description: A collection as staff see it.

AdminFeaturedServer.description: A featured server as staff see it.

AdminNewsItem.description: A news item as staff see it (drafts included).

AdminProduct.description: A product as staff see it (inactive ones included).

trending_rank.description: 1 = most trending; null when not trending.

Capabilities.description: What the account may do right now (age rules + parental controls + bans).

needs_guardian.description: Under the digital-consent age and no guardian linked yet.

discoverable_allowed.description: May appear in (and see) friend suggestions of players met (ADR 0145): adults only.

tax_note.description: Legal display note (e.g. "Prices include VAT." / "Taxes calculated at checkout.").

collections.description: Active collections ordered by `sort`, then name.

trending.description: Product ids by trending rank (best first).

checkout_url.description: Stripe Checkout URL to open; `null` when fully paid by wallet or awaiting a guardian.

ClientKind.description: `web` receives the refresh token in an HttpOnly cookie instead of the body.

oneOf.description: Send every `heartbeat_interval_secs` (see `hello`). Presence expires after 3 missed beats.
Application-level ping; answered by `pong` with the same nonce.

uuid.description: Minecraft UUID hex of the friend's linked profile (Rustic user id hex if none).

to.description: Friend's Minecraft UUID hex (or Rustic user id).

address.description: `host[:port]` of the server the inviter is on.

Conversation.description: One direct-message conversation (most recent first in `GET /v1/conversations`).

asset_version.description: Bundle version on the CDN (empty until published by the pipeline).

asset_hash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the bundle: its CDN address and integrity check.

CosmeticSlot.description:
Cosmetic slots = the cosmetics format's categories (`packages/cosmetics-format`,
`Category`). Purely visual. There is deliberately no cape slot (docs/LEGAL.md).

subdomain_label.description: Request a free `<label>.<relay-domain>` (only when the feature is enabled).

zone.description: Registrable zone the records live in (e.g. `example.com`).

routing_active.description: True when the relay is authorised to route this hostname.

dns_records.description: Registrar-agnostic record set to create, with per-record live check results.

DailyOffers.description: Today's daily offers (one UTC day, same for everyone).

DnsRecord.description:
A DNS record to create at the user's registrar (any registrar: by hand, or by the launcher
through the user's own registrar API keys). `name` is relative to the zone (`@` = apex).

name.description: Record name relative to the zone (what registrar APIs expect as the subdomain).

value.description: TXT content, CNAME target, or SRV `priority weight port target`.

required.description:
Required for verification. For routing, either the CNAME or the SRV record suffices
(apex domains cannot hold a CNAME: use SRV).

emote.description: Emote id (`asset_ref` of an owned emote) or `null` to stop.

ErrorBody.description: Error envelope returned with every non-2xx status.

message.description: Human readable message (English; the UI translates by `code`).

ExternalIdentity.description: A sign-in method linked to the account (`microsoft`).

key.description: Project id or slug (any source: `modrinth:<id>`, `horizon:<id>`, a bare slug...).

FairPlayDenyList.description: The authoritative fair-play deny list (X-ray, auto-clickers, hacks...).

FeaturedServer.description: A server staff feature on the Launchpad and the Servers page.

address.description: `host` or `host:port` players type in the game.

verified.description: Staff checked the owner and the rules.

players_online.description: Not measured by the cloud yet: clients ping the server themselves.

server_name.description: The caller's own name for the server (from their presence), when `reason` is `server`.

seen_at.description: End of the most recent time together.

FriendSuggestions.description: `GET /v1/friends/suggestions` (ADR 0145). Both lists are most recent first, 10 at most.

discoverable.description: `false` when the caller opted out or is a minor: nothing is recorded, lists are empty.

played_with.description: Same party, or the same server for at least 10 minutes in total, in the last 14 days.

crossed.description: Same server at overlapping times in the last 14 days (not already in `played_with`).

code.description: Shown once; only a hash is stored.
Give this code to the guardian; valid 7 days, single use.

HandoffResponse.description: Single-use code (60 s) the website hands to the launcher through `rustic://auth?code=`.

HostingCatalog.description: Rustic Cloud hosting (coming soon): catalog preview, no provisioning.

priceCents.description: Monthly price, VAT included, minor units (indicative: not purchasable yet).

has_password.description: Whether the account can sign in with an email and password.

InviteCode.description:
An invite code for a server (ADR 0105): friends type it in the launcher, the cloud
resolves it to the server's route hostname.

hostname.description: `host` to join (the relay route hostname; port 25565 unless `port` is set).

mfa_token.description: Present when `status = mfa_required`: send it to `/v1/auth/login/mfa` (5 min).

signup_token.description: Present when `status = signup_required` (Microsoft sign-in): 10 min, single use.

email.description: The Microsoft account's email, when `status = signup_required`.

LookupRelation.description: How the caller relates to a looked-up user.

discoverable.description:
"Appear in suggestions of players I meet" as in effect: the setting (default on) and
`capabilities.discoverable_allowed` (always off for minors). ADR 0145.

read_at.description: When the recipient read it (read receipt); `null` while unread.

MicrosoftCompleteRequest.description:
The "complete your account" step of a Microsoft sign-up (same age gate and consent as
an email sign-up).

MicrosoftSignInRequest.description:
"Continue with Microsoft" (ADR 0090): the id_token the website got from Microsoft
(OIDC code flow + PKCE) and the nonce it generated.

MinecraftLinkChallenge.description:
Step 1 of the link (ADR 0011): a one-time `server_id`. The launcher then calls Mojang's
session server `POST /session/minecraft/join` with its own Minecraft token, the profile
UUID and this `server_id`. The token goes to Mojang only, never to Rustic Cloud.

MinecraftLinkFinishRequest.description: Step 2: the API asks Mojang `hasJoined(username, server_id)` and binds the returned UUID.

username.description: Current Minecraft username of the profile that joined.

oneOf.description: `null` when the Minecraft account is not linked to a Rustic account.

body.description: Markdown body (rendered as text by the clients; no raw HTML).

url.description: Where "Read more" goes: the external link when set, else the website's news page.

version.description: Version the item is about (patch notes), if any.

published.description: Publish now (true) or keep as a draft (false).

item_ids.description: Cosmetic items this line grants ("Equip now" after checkout).

monthly_spend_limit_minor.description: Monthly cap in minor units of `spend_limit_currency`; `null` = no cap.

PremiumWaitlist.description: "Premium: coming soon" waitlist status of the caller.

amount_minor.description: Final amount the customer pays, in minor units.

tax_inclusive.description: True when `amount_minor` includes VAT (EU, UK, CH display rule).

oneOf.description: The price actually charged today (the discounted one while a daily offer runs).

owned.description: Only set for authenticated catalog requests.

featured.description: Highlighted by staff (e.g. a large card).

oneOf.description: Today's daily offer on this product in the requested currency, if any.

ProductOffer.description: A daily offer (ADR 0091): the same for every buyer, visible in advance, no random draw.

reference_minor.description:
EU Omnibus reference (Directive 98/6/EC art. 6a): lowest price applied to the product
in this currency during the 30 days before the offer day, in minor units.

ends_at.description: When the offer ends (next UTC midnight).

PublicUser.description: A user as seen by other users (no email, no date of birth).

PurchaseConsent.description:
EU consumer law: explicit request for immediate execution and acknowledgement of the
loss of the 14-day withdrawal right for digital content. Both must be `true`.

wording_version.description: Version of the consent wording displayed (see `GET /v1/store/legal`).

country.description: ISO country of the buyer (VAT rules).

use_wallet.description: Spend wallet credit (redeemed gift cards) first.

marked.description: Messages marked read by this call.

RecordCheck.description: Result of the last DNS check of one expected record.

refresh_token.description: Required for the launcher; the web app sends the cookie instead.

route_hostname.description:
Unique route name `<route-id>.<relay-host>`, always routed: the CNAME/SRV target for
custom domains (ADR 0013), also usable directly by players.

subdomain.description: `<label>.<relay-domain>` when the optional free subdomain feature is enabled.

hostnames.description: Hostnames the relay is authorised to route (verified domains + subdomain).

token.description: Tunnel token for the relay handshake (HS256 JWT, relay ADR 0101, docs/API.md).

hostnames.description: Permanent hostnames (verified custom domains, optional free subdomain).

temp_hostnames.description: Temporary hostnames with their lease expiry.

body.description: 1-2000 characters. Passed through the profanity filter hook.

oneOf.description: Read receipt: `reader_id` read the conversation with you up to `read_at`.

The user accepted a server invitation (e.g. from the in-game companion): the launcher
should (re)start the game into `address`.
`party = null` when the party was disbanded or the user left/was kicked.
The session behind this socket was revoked: the server closes the socket after this.

SetDailyOffersRequest.description: Replaces the offers of one day (at most 12).

SetPasswordRequest.description: First password of an account created with Microsoft.

product_ids.description: Ranks 1..n in this order; every other product loses its rank.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (age rules depend on it).

privacy_policy_version.description: Version of the privacy policy the user accepted at signup.

guardian_required.description:
True when the user is under the digital-consent age of their country: features are
restricted until a guardian links the account.

SkinPng.description: OpenAPI schema of the binary PNG body.

emotes.description: Emotes the account owns (the wheel shows at most 8).

hero.description: Shown as the store's hero banner.

product_ids.description: In display order; only active products of this catalog response.

TempHostnameLease.description:
A temporary relay hostname lease for a server running on the user's machine, plus a
relay token that already carries it.

renew_before.description: Renew before this instant to keep the same hostname.

access_token.description: Short-lived JWT (15 min) for `Authorization: Bearer` and the realtime socket.

refresh_token.description: Opaque rotating refresh token (30 days). Absent for `client = web` (cookie instead).

secret.description: Base32 secret (show once, or render `otpauth_url` as a QR code client-side).

UpdateCollectionRequest.description: Every field optional; `product_ids` replaces the list (in order) when present.

date_of_birth.description: Only accepted while unset (accounts created with Microsoft).

discoverable.description:
Friend suggestions opt-out (ADR 0145). `true` is refused (`discoverable_not_allowed`)
for minors; `false` also deletes the recorded sightings at once.

share_server.description: When false, `activity.server_address` is dropped before fan-out.

UpdateProductRequest.description: Every field optional; `prices` and `item_ids` replace the whole set when present.

UserLookup.description: Exact-match result of `GET /v1/users/lookup`, shown before sending a friend request.

minecraft_name.description: Linked Minecraft profile name. Hidden for minors unless it is what was searched.

request_id.description: Pending incoming request id when `relation` is `incoming_request`.

WaitlistRequest.description: Also accepts the hosting crate's `{"region", "expectedPlayers"}` shape.

ttl.description: Seconds this answer may be cached (60-3600).

players.description: By UUID hex; players wearing nothing are left out.

playing.description: Emotes playing now, by UUID hex.

WornItem.description: One worn cosmetic: where its bundle is on the CDN.

players.description: Up to 64 Minecraft UUIDs (hex, dashes accepted).
